efd0706b-600a-5ac1-926e-cc0602ca0086.content: For the next return, the user sealed the box at home and completed intake in one attempt.

1e8a6f7e-0911-5a34-ad82-172479d1a7a4.content: The user scheduled bank and post-office errands for the same day, but they took a long time because the destinations were in different directions.

2db70f53-99ee-556c-a8c1-b809881cbebd.content: Postal staff expect a return-label barcode to arrive affixed flat, without a fold.

38d60cc4-2f91-5cc2-b511-55cdbbe12c32.content: Before grouping errands into one outing, check each institution's location and operating hours that day.

1272087c-a535-5612-8c7a-1bc257183788.content: Postal and financial counters may operate on different hours than usual around public holidays.
